balanced_default.rationale: Best robust compromise across hit frequency, 4+ coverage and current jackpot tilt.

hit_frequency.rationale: Highest archive 3+ frequency / mean best among tested mixed allocations.

jackpot_tilt.rationale: Higher 6/49 exposure while retaining 6/42; best archive 4+ rate among tested allocations.

rejected_as_default.rationale: Maximizes jackpot-value tilt but materially gives up hit frequency and mean best-hit performance.

decision: Use 8+16 as the default ~€20 allocation while the confirmed 6/49 jackpot-value advantage is moderate (~24%). Use 14+9 only as an explicit jackpot-tilt choice; do not default to 16+6.
caveats: Lottery draws remain unpredictable; historical hit-rate differences do not imply future predictability.
Official payout sample is only 13 common draws and is secondary evidence.
Jackpot EV ignores sharing with other jackpot winners.
Do not increase the precommitted budget in response to recent draws.
